a: $100,000 to $4 million per proposal (smaller requests allowed in mathematics and from non-PhD-granting institutions); about 60 awards, $50M expected
dt: FY2027 solicitation NSF 27-500 (published Nov 6, 2026): submission windows Jan 4 to Jan 29, 2027 and Oct 18 to Nov 19, 2027, due 5 pm submitter's local time
e: Funds acquisition or development of multi-user research instruments. Under NSF 27-500 there is no limit on proposals per organization or per PI, and voluntary committed cost sharing is not allowed.

yale.t: Yale ran an internal competition for NSF MRI under the old solicitation NSF 23-519 (closed Apr 13, 2026). NSF 27-500 sets no limit on proposals per organization; check the Yale Funding Opportunities newsletter for any internal step.
yale.unv: Source is the Mar 11, Mar 18, Apr 1 and Apr 8, 2026 Yale Funding Opportunities newsletters.
